title.zh: 原跋 宋天聖二年隋書刊本原跋
title.en: Volume 86: the Second Year of the Tian Sheng Reign Publication Mark
title.raw: 原跋 宋天聖二年隋書刊本原跋 Volume 86: the Second Year of the Tian Sheng Reign Publication Mark

sentences.zh: 隋書自開皇、仁壽時，王劭為書八十卷，以類相從，定為篇目。

translations.literal: As for the Book of Sui, from the Kaihuang and Renshou periods, Wang Shao made a book of eighty juan, arranging material by category to fix the section headings.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaihuang and Renshou reigns, Wang Shao compiled an eighty-juan history of the Sui, grouping entries by category to establish its table of contents.

sentences.zh: 至於編年紀傳，並闕其體。

translations.literal: As for annalistic chronicle and biographical formats, both forms were lacking.
translations.idiomatic: It lacked both the annalistic chronicle and the standard biographical formats.

sentences.zh: 唐武德五年，起居舍人令狐德棻奏請修五代史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wude of Tang, Attendant Diarist Linghu Defen memorialized requesting compilation of the histories of the Five Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Wude, Attendant Diarist Linghu Defen submitted a memorial asking that the histories of the Five Dynasties be compiled.

sentences.zh: 〈五代謂梁、陳、齊、周、隋也。〉

translations.literal: 〈The "Five Dynasties" means Liang, Chen, Qi, Zhou, and Sui.〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈The "Five Dynasties" refers to Liang, Chen, Northern Qi, Northern Zhou, and Sui.〉

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔中書令封德彝、舍人顏師古修隋史，緜歷數載，不就而罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered Grand Counselor Feng Deyi and Attendant Yan Shigu to compile the Sui history; it extended over several years, was not completed, and the project was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict appointed Grand Counselor Feng Deyi and Attendant Yan Shigu to compile the Sui history; after several years without completion, the project was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 貞觀三年，續詔秘書監魏徵修隋史，左僕射房喬總監。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenguan, a further edict appointed Director of the Imperial Library Wei Zheng to compile the Sui history, with Left Vice Director Fang Qiao as overall supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenguan, a new edict put Director of the Imperial Library Wei Zheng in charge of compiling the Sui history, with Left Vice Director Fang Qiao as overall supervisor.

sentences.zh: 徵又奏於中書省置秘書內省，令前中書侍郎顏師古、給事中孔穎達、著作郎許敬宗撰隋史。

translations.literal: Wei also memorialized establishing an inner secretariat office within the Secretariat, ordering former Vice Director of the Secretariat Yan Shigu, Supernumerary within the Gates Kong Yingda, and Academician Xu Jingzong to compile the Sui history.
translations.idiomatic: Wei also proposed setting up an inner secretariat bureau within the Secretariat and assigning former Vice Director Yan Shigu, Supernumerary within the Gates Kong Yingda, and Academician Xu Jingzong to write the Sui history.

sentences.zh: 徵總知其務，多所損益，務存簡正。

translations.literal: Wei personally oversaw the task, making many cuts and additions, striving to keep the text concise and correct.
translations.idiomatic: Wei directed the work himself, revising extensively while keeping the text concise and accurate.

sentences.zh: 序、論皆徵所作。

translations.literal: The prefaces and discussions were all composed by Wei.
translations.idiomatic: All prefaces and evaluative essays were written by Wei.

sentences.zh: 凡成帝紀五，列傳五十。

translations.literal: In all there were completed five imperial annals and fifty biographies.
translations.idiomatic: In all, five imperial annals and fifty biographies were completed.

sentences.zh: 十年正月壬子，徵等詣闕上之。

translations.literal: On the day renzi of the first month of the tenth year, Wei and the others went to the palace gate to present it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi of the first month of the tenth year, Wei and his colleagues presented the work at court.

sentences.zh: 十五年，又詔左僕射于志寧、太史令李淳風、著作郎韋安仁、符璽郎李延壽同修五代史志。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, another edict ordered Left Vice Director Yu Zhining, Grand Astrologer Li Chunfeng, Academician Wei Anren, and Seal Keeper Li Yanshou jointly to compile the treatises of the Five Dynasties history.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, another edict commissioned Left Vice Director Yu Zhining, Grand Astrologer Li Chunfeng, Academician Wei Anren, and Seal Keeper Li Yanshou jointly to compile the treatises for the Five Dynasties history.

sentences.zh: 凡勒成十志三十卷。

translations.literal: In all ten treatises were compiled into thirty juan.
translations.idiomatic: Ten treatises in thirty juan were completed in all.

sentences.zh: 顯慶元年五月己卯，太尉長孫無忌等詣朝堂上進，詔藏秘閣。

translations.literal: On the day jimao of the fifth month of the first year of Xianqing, Grand Commandant Zhangsun Wuji and others went to the court hall to present it; an edict ordered it stored in the Imperial Archive.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao of the fifth month of the first year of Xianqing, Grand Commandant Zhangsun Wuji and others presented it in the court hall; an edict ordered it deposited in the Imperial Archive.

sentences.zh: 後又編第入隋書，其實別行，亦呼為五代史志。

translations.literal: Later it was again arranged by fascicle and incorporated into the Book of Sui; in fact it circulated separately, and was also called the Treatises of the Five Dynasties History.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was re-fascicled and bound into the Book of Sui, though it had in fact circulated as a separate work and was also known as the Treatises of the Five Dynasties History.

sentences.zh: 〈案魏徵本傳，貞觀七年為侍中，十年，五代史成，加光祿大夫，進封鄭國公。

translations.literal: 〈According to Wei Zheng's standard biography, in the seventh year of Zhenguan he became Palace Attendant; in the tenth year, when the Five Dynasties history was completed, he was advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and enfeoffed as Duke of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: 〈According to Wei Zheng's standard biography, in the seventh year of Zhenguan he became Palace Attendant; when the Five Dynasties history was finished in the tenth year, he was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and enfeoffed as Duke of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 俄請遜位，拜特進。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he requested to yield his position and was appointed Specially Advanced.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he asked to step down and was appointed Specially Advanced.

sentences.zh: 今諸本並云特進。

translations.literal: Now all editions uniformly read "Specially Advanced."
translations.idiomatic: All extant editions now read "Specially Advanced."

sentences.zh: 又經籍志四卷，獨云侍中、鄭國公魏徵撰。

translations.literal: Also, in the Bibliographic Treatise in four juan, it alone says "composed by Palace Attendant, Duke of Zheng, Wei Zheng."
translations.idiomatic: The Bibliographic Treatise in four juan, by contrast, credits it solely to "Palace Attendant and Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng."

sentences.zh: 无忌傳又云，永徽三年，始受詔監修，疑當時先已刊修，无忌因成書而進。

translations.literal: Zhangsun Wuji's biography also states that in the third year of Yonghui he first received the edict to supervise compilation—it is suspected that the text had already been cut and revised earlier, and Wuji presented the work because the book was finished.
translations.idiomatic: Wuji's biography also says he first received the edict to supervise compilation in the third year of Yonghui—which suggests the text had already been edited earlier and that Wuji presented it only after the book was complete.

sentences.zh: 今紀傳題以徵，志以无忌，從眾本所載也。

translations.literal: Now the annals and biographies are titled under Wei, the treatises under Wuji, following what the various editions record.
translations.idiomatic: The present edition titles the annals and biographies under Wei and the treatises under Wuji, following the various exemplars.

sentences.zh: 紀傳亦有題太子少師許敬宗撰。

translations.literal: The annals and biographies also sometimes bear the title "composed by Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Xu Jingzong."
translations.idiomatic: Some copies of the annals and biographies also credit "Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Xu Jingzong" as compiler.

sentences.zh: 案敬宗傳，貞觀八年，除著作郎，修國史，遷中書舍人。

translations.literal: According to Xu Jingzong's biography, in the eighth year of Zhenguan he was appointed Academician and compiled the dynastic history, then was transferred to Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jingzong's biography records that in the eighth year of Zhenguan he was made Academician, worked on the dynastic history, and was then promoted to Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 十年，左授洪州司馬。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was demoted and assigned as Administrator of Hongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was demoted to administrator of Hongzhou.

sentences.zh: 龍朔三年，始拜太子少師。

translations.literal: In the third year of Longshuo he was first appointed Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Not until the third year of Longshuo was he appointed Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 與今錄年月官位不同，疑後人所益。

translations.literal: This differs from the dates and offices recorded in the present text—suspected to have been added by a later hand.
translations.idiomatic: These dates and titles differ from those in the present record, which suggests a later interpolation.

sentences.zh: 房喬、志寧初並受詔。

translations.literal: Fang Qiao and Yu Zhining at first both received the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Qiao and Yu Zhining had both originally received imperial orders to compile.

sentences.zh: 又《李延壽傳》云，被詔與著作佐郎敬播同修五代史志。

translations.literal: Also, 《Biography of Li Yanshou》 states that he was ordered together with Assistant Academician Jing Bo jointly to compile the treatises of the Five Dynasties history.
translations.idiomatic: Also, 《Biography of Li Yanshou》 states that he was ordered, together with Assistant Academician Jing Bo, to compile the treatises of the Five Dynasties history.

sentences.zh: 按延壽貞觀三年與顏師古同被勑修隋史，其年以內憂去職。

translations.literal: According to this, in the third year of Zhenguan Li Yanshou was ordered together with Yan Shigu to compile the Sui history; that same year he left office due to mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yanshou was in fact ordered with Yan Shigu in the third year of Zhenguan to compile the Sui history but left office that same year to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 今諸本並不載喬等名位。

translations.literal: Now various editions uniformly do not list the names and offices of Qiao and the others.
translations.idiomatic: None of the extant editions now records the names and offices of Qiao and the others.

sentences.zh: 天文、律曆、五行三志，皆淳風獨作。

translations.literal: The three treatises on astronomy, calendrical systems, and the Five Phases were all composed solely by Li Chunfeng.
translations.idiomatic: The treatises on astronomy, calendrical systems, and the Five Phases were all written by Li Chunfeng alone.

sentences.zh: 五行志序，諸本云褚遂良作。

translations.literal: The preface to the treatise on the Five Phases—in various editions it says composed by Chu Suiliang.
translations.idiomatic: Various editions attribute the preface to the treatise on the Five Phases to Chu Suiliang.

sentences.zh: 案本傳未嘗受詔撰述，疑祗為一序，今故略其名氏。〉

translations.literal: According to his standard biography he never received an edict to compile; it is suspected this was only a preface—hence his name is omitted here.〉
translations.idiomatic: His standard biography, however, records no commission to compile; this was probably only a preface, and so his name is omitted here.〉

sentences.zh: 天聖二年五月十一日上。

translations.literal: Presented on the eleventh day of the fifth month of the second year of Tiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: Presented on the eleventh day of the fifth month of the second year of Tiansheng.

sentences.zh: 御藥供奉藍元用奉傳聖旨，齎禁中《隋書》一部，付崇文院。

translations.literal: Imperial Pharmacy Attendant Lan Yuanyong, conveying the imperial command, carried one copy of 《Book of Sui》 from within the palace and delivered it to the Chongwen Court.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Pharmacy Attendant Lan Yuanyong, acting on the imperial command, brought one palace copy of 《Book of Sui》 and delivered it to the Chongwen Court.

sentences.zh: 至六月五日，勑差官校勘，

translations.literal: By the fifth day of the sixth month, an edict commissioned officials to collate and revise it,
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the sixth month an edict appointed officials to collate the text,

sentences.zh: 〈時命臣綬、臣燁提點，右正言、直史館張觀等校勘。

translations.literal: 〈At that time Ministers Shou and Ye were appointed to supervise; Right Remonstrator and Direct Historian of the History Office Zhang Guan and others collated the text.
translations.idiomatic: 〈At that time Ministers Shou and Ye were appointed to supervise; Right Remonstrator and Direct Historian of the History Office Zhang Guan and others carried out the collation.

sentences.zh: 觀尋為度支判官，續命黃鑑代之。〉

translations.literal: Guan was shortly afterward made Revenue Commission Assessor; Huang Jian was then appointed to replace him.〉
translations.idiomatic: Guan was soon transferred to the revenue assessor post, and Huang Jian was appointed to replace him.〉

sentences.zh: 仍內出版式雕造。

translations.literal: It was still to be carved and printed in the palace edition format.
translations.idiomatic: The work was then carved and printed in the palace edition format.
